maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is rent and resident income from owned seniors housing and skilled nursing properties, not repair or servicing work.

publicly_funded.reason: Mostly seniors housing (SHOP) paid privately by residents; skilled nursing is about 30% of the portfolio.

serial_acquirer.reason: A REIT that grows by investing in properties, financing and joint ventures, not by buying companies in a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Landlord and financing provider of seniors housing properties; operators and capital sources are substitutable, though long leases add some friction.

notes: Mission-critical is a judgement call because operators on long leases face some relocation costs.
